0022600004.text: The Miami Heat host the Minnesota Timberwolves in a game that opens the 2026-27 season for both teams, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Heat a 50% chance to win. The Timberwolves beat the Heat 122-94 in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026, and Miami lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season series. Miami is without Bam Adebayo, Dru Smith, Giannis Antetokounmpo and Pelle Larsson, who are all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, and has Anthony Edwards, Ayo Dosunmu, Bones Hyland, Enrique Freeman, Jaden McDaniels, Jonathan Kuminga, LaMelo Ball, Rocco Zikarsky, Rudy Gobert and Trey Lyles listed as day-to-day.
